exclusions.debtAndStructuredProducts: tier1 Debt and Structured Products / 債券及結構性產品 / code 70000, including cancelled or reissued prefixes; also Documents on Display for debt issuance programmes (57000), debt securities (58000), and structured products (59000)
exclusions.monthlyReturns: tier1 Monthly Returns / 月報表 / code 51500, contains match, including cancelled or reissued prefixes
exclusions.ndrShareBuyback: Next Day Disclosure Returns with Share Buyback in tier2 or category, or an explicit Share Buyback title; cancelled or reissued prefixes included; standard NDR form wording (and/or share buybacks) kept; AGM repurchase circulars kept
exclusions.warrantsOptionsCbbc: Warrants, options, and CBBCs (牛熊證 / 窩輪 / 認股證): stock codes >=10000 and derivative name markers stripped from the issuer universe and from filing rows

note: Beta whole-market cache from on-demand HKEXnews market-wide monthly pulls on 11 November 2026 (Asia/Hong_Kong). Main Board + GEM equity/ETF issuers (stock codes 00001–09999). Each incremental run re-pulls the last 14 calendar days in Asia/Hong_Kong even when the monthly raw file is already complete. Cache rows for Monthly Returns, NDR Share Buybacks, Debt and Structured Products (債券及結構性產品, including related debt and structured-product documents on display), and warrants, options, and CBBCs (牛熊證) are stripped at build (not only hidden in the UI). Metadata and FILE_LINK hyperlinks only; PDF bodies are not stored.
pairing: Match EN↔TC by NEWS_ID within ±5 (usually ±1) on the same DATE_TIME; fall back to closest unused same-time TC row within ±20. Drop EN stubs that only say published in Chinese. Require real PDF FILE_LINKs on both sides. Bilingual open only for paired rows.
